desc: Ideate approaches and select Fenwick tree sliding-window median cost plus interval DP.
Implement Fenwick tree count/sum structures over compressed `nums` to maintain the sliding window and query median absolute-deviation cost in `O(log n)`.
Generate the full `cost` array where `cost[i]` is the minimum operations needed to make `nums[i:i+x]` all equal.
Implement DP over window starts to select `k` non-overlapping windows using the previous DP layer at `i - x` and prefix-min style transitions.
Integrate the cost computation and DP into `Solution.minOperations`.
Run the provided sample tests and a small random brute-force validator against the current implementation; if any test fails, identify the failing case and fix the median cost or DP indexing.
